blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: formar el past continuous con was / were + -ing
describir lo que estaba pasando en un momento del pasado
distinguir el fondo y el suceso de una historia

blocks.label: verbo regular
examples: I was reading when you called.
She was reading in the garden.
Ella estaba leyendo en el jardín.
We were reading the same book.

head: Afirmativa
Negación
Pregunta
rows: I was sleeping.
I wasn't sleeping.
Were you sleeping?
It was raining.
It wasn't raining.
Was it raining?
They were working.
They weren't working.
Were they working?

head: Uso
Ejemplo
Español
rows: En curso en un momento del pasado
At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
A las ocho estaba cenando.
El fondo de una historia
The sun was shining and birds were singing.
Brillaba el sol y cantaban los pájaros.
Interrumpido por algo
I was cooking when the phone rang.
Estaba cocinando cuando sonó el teléfono.
Dos cosas a la vez
While I was reading, he was watching TV.
Mientras yo leía, él veía la tele.

blocks.title: estaba haciendo = was doing, pero el imperfecto no siempre
blocks.text: Estaba leyendo es siempre I was reading. El imperfecto español también lo es cuando describe algo en curso: Llovía = It was raining. Pero el imperfecto de costumbre no: De niño jugaba al fútbol = As a child I played football (o I used to play, pdf 7), nunca I was playing.
La acción larga (el fondo) va en past continuous, el suceso corto que la interrumpe en past simple. while (mientras) suele ir con la acción larga, when (cuando) con la corta.

head: Inglés
Español
rows: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Volvía a casa andando cuando empezó a llover.
While she was driving, her phone rang.
Mientras conducía, le sonó el teléfono.
When I arrived, they were having lunch.
Cuando llegué, estaban comiendo.
When I arrived, they had lunch.
Cuando llegué, se pusieron a comer.

blocks.title: Fíjate en la diferencia
blocks.text: When I arrived, they were having lunch: ya estaban comiendo. When I arrived, they had lunch: empezaron a comer cuando llegué. La forma cambia el orden de los sucesos, igual que comían y comieron en español.

blocks.title: Sin -ing con los estados
blocks.text: Como en presente: los verbos como know, like, want y need no llevan -ing. I knew the answer (sabía la respuesta), no I was knowing.

rows: I was sleep when you called.
I was sleeping when you called.
Después de was va la forma en -ing.
They was playing football.
They were playing football.
Con they: were.
While I watched TV, the lights went out.
While I was watching TV, the lights went out.
La acción larga: past continuous.
I was walking home when it was starting to rain.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
El suceso corto: past simple.
I was knowing her.
I knew her.
know no lleva -ing.
What did you do at ten o'clock last night? I slept.
What were you doing at ten o'clock last night? I was sleeping.
En curso en un momento: past continuous.

blocks.text: Completa con el past simple o el past continuous. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: I ______ a shower when the doorbell rang.
items.full: I was having a shower when the doorbell rang.

items.q: It ______ when we left the house.
items.full: It was raining when we left the house.

items.q: While they ______ dinner, the lights went out.
items.full: While they were cooking dinner, the lights went out.

items.q: She was driving when she ______ the accident.
items.full: She was driving when she saw the accident.

items.q: What ______ you doing at nine o'clock?
items.full: What were you doing at nine o'clock?

items.q: We ______ sleeping. We were watching a film.
items.full: We weren't sleeping. We were watching a film.

items.q: I ______ my wallet while I was shopping.
items.full: I lost my wallet while I was shopping.

items.q: The children ______ in the garden all afternoon.
items.full: The children were playing in the garden all afternoon.
Was he working when you called?

items.a: I was reading when you called.
At eight o'clock I was having dinner.
